name: sg-semicon-expansion-plugin
description: Support Singapore semiconductor SMEs with US expansion research, company profiling, and capability-to-buyer mapping.

interface.shortDescription: Profile SMEs and map US buyer fit.
interface.longDescription: Profiles Singapore semiconductor and adjacent companies into a structured workbook, and maps SME capabilities into search-ready US prospecting angles for market-entry research.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use this plugin to profile a Singapore semiconductor SME URL into data/companies.xlsx, or map an SME capability into US buyer-search queries.
